constraints.title: Padding boundary
constraints.rule: The GCD of the gaps between distinct ciphertext lengths is the padding boundary, and it must equal the suite's max(block, 4).

constraints.title: Length residue
constraints.rule: Every ciphertext length satisfies len mod boundary == (IV + ICV) mod boundary; at least 90% must agree.

constraints.title: Minimum size
constraints.rule: The shortest ciphertext must hold the suite's IV and ICV plus 4 bytes of padding, pad length and next header.

constraints.title: Payload entropy
constraints.rule: Encrypting suites need mean entropy of at least 6.8 bits/byte; ESP-NULL must not exceed 7.2.

classes.name: AES-CBC with 96-bit ICV
classes.why_inseparable: This class has a single member, so the framing identifies the suite exactly.

findings.title: Association provides only 96-bit security
findings.detail: Component strengths: encryption 128 bits, prf 96 bits, integrity 96 bits, key_exchange 112 bits. The association is bounded by its prf at 96 bits, which is graded 'deprecated'. A strong cipher does not compensate for a weak key exchange: an attacker who recovers the session key never has to attack the cipher at all.
findings.remediation: Raise the prf to at least the 128-bit level. The whole suite should be re-specified together rather than patched component by component.

findings.title: ESP tunnel using AES-CBC with 96-bit ICV
findings.subject: 203.0.113.21->198.51.100.33:0xecc3f80c
findings.detail: Packet framing on this SA matches block 16, IV 16, ICV 12, which identifies AES-CBC-128 / HMAC-SHA1-96. SHA-1 truncated to 96 bits; CBC lacks integrated authentication. Inferred from 680 packets at 100% confidence in the framing class.
findings.reference: RFC 4303 s2; RFC 8221; NIST SP 800-77 Rev. 1 s4.1
findings.remediation: Reconfigure the child SA proposal to AES-GCM-256 and confirm from the gateway's own SA table.

findings.title: Deprecated integrity algorithm: AUTH_HMAC_SHA1_96
findings.detail: SHA-1 is deprecated for new systems (SP 800-131A Rev. 2)

findings.title: No quantum-resistant key establishment
findings.detail: The SA relies entirely on classical Diffie-Hellman. Traffic recorded today can be decrypted once a cryptanalytically relevant quantum computer exists, which matters for material whose sensitivity outlives the hardware.
findings.remediation: Deploy an RFC 8784 post-quantum pre-shared key now, and enable a hybrid ML-KEM key exchange (Group 35-37) as gateway firmware allows.

findings.title: Broken transforms remain in the proposal set
findings.detail: The initiator advertised transforms that policy prohibits: AUTH_HMAC_MD5_96, DH group 2, ENCR_3DES. Even unselected, they widen the downgrade surface — an on-path attacker who can drop the strong proposals may force a fallback.
findings.remediation: Prune the gateway's transform set to approved algorithms only, so a downgrade has nothing to fall back to.

findings.title: Deprecated PRF: PRF_HMAC_SHA1
findings.detail: SHA-1-based PRF is deprecated for new systems

findings.title: IKEv2 fragmentation not negotiated
findings.detail: Neither peer advertised RFC 7383 fragmentation. Certificate-bearing IKE_AUTH messages then rely on IP fragmentation, which middleboxes on carrier paths routinely drop — a common cause of tunnels that establish with PSK but fail with certificates.
findings.remediation: Enable IKEv2 fragmentation on both peers before migrating to certificate auth.

finding_groups.title: Association provides only 96-bit security
finding_groups.why_it_matters: A connection is only as strong as its weakest part, and one part of this one is below the level required for sensitive information.

finding_groups.why_it_matters: The device still offers weak options, so an attacker in the middle could push the connection onto them even when today's session is strong.

throughput.note: Capture too small to measure throughput: 684 packets, fewer than the 10,000 needed for a stable rate. Run `cipherguard bench` for a reproducible figure.

assumptions.note: The CRQC arrival estimate is a planning assumption, not a prediction. Substitute the agency's own figure; the ranking of links is unchanged by it, only the urgency framing.

links.rationale: MODP key exchange at 96 classical bits and zero quantum bits. Every session key on this link is recoverable by Shor's algorithm from recorded traffic.

phases.action: Replace broken classical cryptography first. These links are exposed to a conventional attacker today, so the quantum timeline is not the binding constraint — fix them regardless of PQC readiness.
phases.target: AES-GCM-256, DH Group 19 or 31, IKEv2, certificate auth

provenance.report_digest_covers: SHA-256 over the sorted rule-ID:subject pair of every finding, first 16 hex digits. Two reports with the same digest raised the same findings on the same links.

remediation.fortinet:
# CipherGuard hardening plan - Fortinet FortiOS
# Generated 2026-09-26T10:20:16+00:00 from capture 'transitional.pcap'
# Posture score 48/100 (grade D) - 0 critical, 1 high
#
# REVIEW BEFORE APPLYING. Staged as new policy entries; nothing existing
# is removed. Cut over during a change window, verify the tunnel
# re-establishes, then retire the old policy.
#
# Findings addressed by this plan:
#   [high    ] IKE-012 (observed) Association provides only 96-bit security
#   [medium  ] ESP-001 (inferred) ESP tunnel using AES-CBC with 96-bit ICV
#   [medium  ] IKE-005 (observed) Deprecated integrity algorithm: AUTH_HMAC_SHA1_96
#   [medium  ] IKE-007 (observed) No quantum-resistant key establishment
#   [medium  ] IKE-008 (observed) Broken transforms remain in the proposal set
#   [low     ] IKE-005 (observed) Deprecated PRF: PRF_HMAC_SHA1
#   [low     ] IKE-011 (observed) IKEv2 fragmentation not negotiated
#
config vpn ipsec phase1-interface
    edit "cg-hardened"
        set ike-version 2
        set proposal aes256gcm-prfsha256
        set dhgrp 19
        set authmethod signature
        set keylife 86400
        set dpd on-idle
    next
end

config vpn ipsec phase2-interface
    edit "cg-hardened-p2"
        set phase1name "cg-hardened"
        set proposal aes256gcm
        set pfs enable
        set dhgrp 19
        set keylifeseconds 28800
    next
end

# Aggressive Mode must be off. Verify with:
#   show vpn ipsec phase1-interface | grep mode
